mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.4% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.4%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.45 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1450.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 102.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal persistent inflationary pressures and a hawkish monetary stance, which together compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 695 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are above threshold, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 156.3 million and a decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a labor market overheating, which increases inflation expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 156300.0 and UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 20.4 trillion dollars, combined with rising residential construction, signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are above threshold, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
